Theorem 1 (Chapter 132)

Subject: semiconductor physics | ID: 30423

Statement

If X is a Paley-Wiener space and T: X -> X is a torsion-free operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the bounded operator \(B_{01320011}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the bounded decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01320011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320011\).

Step 2. Applying the infinite-dimensional interpolation theorem to \(T_{01320012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the compact spectral family \(S_{01320013}\), the image is precompact in the projective variety topology.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
